parties.popularity_note: Aslan Maskhadov's share (61.82%) as the party's presidential candidate in January 1997; no party-list vote is reported.
parties.note: Founded 27 May 1993. Its ticket (Aslan Maskhadov and Vakha Arsanov) won the 1997 presidential election and it won 20 of 63 seats in Parliament. The party infobox names Maskhadov as president and Ruslan Kutayev as current leader, without dates, so no leader history is recorded. Wikipedia lists conservatism and a mixed economy; blue is its colour.
parties.review_note: Leaders and their dates are not given by the source (Maskhadov is named as party president without dates).
